_howto: Add an event: copy one block, change the values. date = YYYY-MM-DD. image = path to a photo inside assets/images/events/. Newest first is sorted automatically. Delete the sample blocks when you add real ones.

items.title: Free sugar & BP check camp
items.text: Sample event — a free blood sugar and blood pressure check was held at the counter on Saturday morning. Replace this with your own event.

items.title: New stock: winter medicines
items.text: Sample event — cough syrups, vaporizers and nebulizer masks have arrived for the winter season. Replace this with your own update.
